title: Farm near Amersfoort (map point estimated): farm worker, about 50, shot dead in hostage incident; gunman then shot himself, 10 Oct
summary: Police say they were called to a hostage situation on a farm near Amersfoort at about 06:00 on Saturday 10 October and found three people who had escaped. A 55-year-old armed man allegedly held farm workers hostage, then...
story: Police say they were called to a hostage situation on a farm near Amersfoort at about 06:00 on Saturday 10 October and found three people who had escaped. A 55-year-old armed man allegedly held farm workers hostage, then shot one, aged about 50, dead and shot another, aged about 53, who survived and was airlifted to hospital (police spokesperson Brigadier Donald Mdhluli, via The Citizen). This pin counts that one killing. Note: while police negotiators were talking to him, the gunman reportedly shot himself and was certified dead at the scene; his death is recorded here as a note, not counted as a killing. A 9mm pistol was found. Cases of murder, attempted murder and kidnapping were opened. No one is named in the report. One report, resting on police: The Citizen, 10 October. MAP POINT ESTIMATED: the farm is not named, so the pin sits on the Amersfoort police station. It is not the scene; the farm may be up to about 43 km away.
